name: second-brain
description: One Git-native project knowledge folder for Claude, Codex, and optional Obsidian, with fixed properties, project tags, visible provenance, read-only health reports, owner-approved saves, and safe migration.

interface.shortDescription: One Markdown project brain for agents and people.
interface.longDescription: Installs one knowledge folder containing the project overview, generated index, specifications, seven durable memory types, project-specific tags, visible provenance, read-only health reports, raw brainstorms, and minimal optional Obsidian settings. Claude and Codex share the same Markdown and Git truth. Saves remain owner-approved, startup loads only the map, and migration detects flat, retired, mixed, unknown, and new layouts without guessing.
